duration.text: The Human Anatomy and Histology and Embryology at Shenyang Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of undergraduate school 5.Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents 7.Resume Written in Chinese or in English 8. Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning)

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 2. Be Healthy. 3. Above the age of 20 and under the age of 35 4.Have attained Bachelor Degree with good marks. 5.Have solid financial support to afford the study and living expense in China.
